repo_actual_inventory.description: Examples physically present in target repo main branch

sources: repo_actual + single PR package on disk
repo_actual + multiple PR packages on disk
batch_overlay_inventory.use_case: Multi-package batch PR or cumulative backfill

pending_evidence_only_inventory.description: Examples PR-ready/package-ready but NOT in target branch
sources: PR dry-run packages not yet merged
pending_evidence_only_inventory.use_case: Evidence reporting only — MUST NOT appear in README present-tense sections

source_priority: 1. Target repo actual checkout (GitHub API / local clone) — highest
2. Post-merge validation JSON — second (verified after merge)
3. PR dry-run package on disk — third (verified locally)
hard_rule: README 'Included Examples' MUST list ONLY examples present in the target branch after PR merge
